_doc: 8 cognitive concepts symmetric for two-speaker dialogue. Subset of v3 cognitive concepts plus two response-oriented additions (patient, skeptical). Reproduces Anthropic emotion paper's Table 14 setup but for cognitive states. Banned stems force show-don't-tell.

concepts.name: curious
concepts.show_through: asks 'why' / 'how' / 'tell me more', digs deeper into details, follows interesting threads, requests examples

concepts.name: uncertain
concepts.show_through: uses 'maybe' / 'I think' / 'I'm not sure', qualifies claims, asks for second opinion, hedges before committing

concepts.name: confident
concepts.show_through: makes direct assertions without hedging, gives specific recommendations, doesn't ask for validation, uses 'definitely' / 'clearly'

concepts.name: confused
concepts.show_through: says 'wait, what?' / 'I don't follow' / 'can you say that again', requests rephrasing, mixes up details, asks clarifying questions about basics

concepts.name: surprised
concepts.show_through: uses 'really?!' / 'I didn't expect that', exclamatory register shift, repeats what the other said in disbelief, pauses mid-sentence

concepts.name: stubborn
concepts.show_through: repeats their original position despite counter-evidence, says 'I still think...' / 'no, that's wrong', refuses to update, dismisses alternatives

concepts.name: thoughtful
concepts.show_through: takes pauses before responding, restates the other's point to confirm, asks one question and waits, considers carefully before stating an opinion, comfortable with silence

concepts.name: skeptical
concepts.show_through: asks 'how do you know that?' / 'what's your evidence?', pushes back on claims, requests proof, doesn't accept assertions at face value
